name: debt-tracker
description: A local desktop application for tracking debt paydown.
author: Debt Tracker

scripts.dev: npm run native:electron && npm run app:metadata -- electron-vite --config ./electron.vite.config.cjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run app:metadata -- electron-vite build --config ./electron.vite.config.cjs
scripts.test: npm run native:node && vitest run --config ./vitest.config.mjs --configLoader runner
scripts.test:integration: npm run native:node && vitest run --config ./vitest.config.mjs --configLoader runner src/main/database/database.integration.test.ts src/main/services/debt-maintenance-service.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run native:electron && playwright test
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run db:check && npm run test:e2e
scripts.package: npm run assets:icons && npm run build && npm run native:electron && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.package:dir: npm run assets:icons && npm run build && npm run native:electron && electron-builder --win dir --x64
